profile.ja: “トゥーハンド（２挺拳銃）”の異名をとる、ラグーン商会所属のガンマン。　瞬間湯沸かし器並みの短気な性格で、トラブルを引き起こすことも……。　子供の頃からスラム街で暮らし、過去に触れられることを極度に嫌う。　米系中国人。
profile.en: They are known as "Two-Hand" - a gunman from the Lagun Corporation, with a short temper that can spark trouble at any moment, much like an instant boiler. They grew up on the streets of the slums and have an intense dislike for discussing their past. They are of Chinese-American descent.

text.ja: レヴィだ。あたしと組むなら、覚悟はできてるんだろうな？
text.en: I'm Levi. If you're going to team up with me, you'd better be ready.

text.ja: “死にたくなきゃ撃て”生き残るための合言葉さ。あんたも覚えておきな、命張るってのはそういうことだ
text.en: "If you don't want to die, shoot" - that's our motto for surviving. You should remember it too, Captain - that's what it means to put your life on the line.

text.ja: 喧嘩売るなら買ってやる。……ただし、手加減はしねぇ。生き残れるかは、そいつの運と度胸次第だな
text.en: If you're looking for a fight, I'll take you on. ...But don't expect any mercy. Whether you survive or not depends on your luck and guts.

text.ja: 心配すんなって。どんな地獄でも、あたしが引き金引いてれば、だいたいなんとかなる
text.en: Don't worry about it. No matter what kind of hell we're in, as long as I've got my trigger finger, we'll probably be okay.

text.ja: ロマンも信仰もクソ喰らえだ。綺麗事で死ぬ気はねぇ
text.en: Romance and faith are just crap. I'm not going to die for some fancy idea.

text.ja: おいおい、どこほっつき歩いてたんだ？　バカンスか？　ま、帰ってきたならよしとするか
text.en: Where have you been wandering off to? On vacation? Well, since you're back, I suppose that's fine.

text.ja: 黙ってると退屈なんだよ、こっちは。何か仕事よこしな、遊びでもケンカでもいいぜ
text.en: It's boring when you're quiet, so come on - give me something to do, whether it's work or a fight.

text.ja: ちょっと貸しな。銃の使い方をレクチャーしてやる。ったく、特別だからな？
text.en: Lend me a hand for a bit. I'll teach you how to use a gun. Just this once, got it?
